## Preferred Summary

Logan Garth Goodwin is a cybersecurity and IT operations professional based in Somersworth, New Hampshire. His portfolio includes network security projects, infrastructure architecture, an A-graded NSSD network security training manual, a Windows 11 Pro cybersecurity workstation build, incident response analysis, GRC documentation, NCL competition proof, technical writing, Amazon-published books, web/app builds, a Windows 11 Pro workstation setup article, and a published Windows 11 family cybersecurity guide.
